29:56:1.noteEnglish: QAC tags this word NOM, contradicting the vocalised form and its role. يَـٰعِبَادِىَ: an annexed vocative (منادیٰ مضاف) is accusative; the kasra before the first-person ya means the nasb is implied.

29:56:5.noteEnglish: QAC tags أَرْضِى nominative, but in إِنَّ أَرْضِى وَٰسِعَةٌ it is the noun (ism) of إِنَّ, with وَٰسِعَةٌ as its predicate: accusative, the nasb implied before the first-person ya (the generated i'rab line's مرفوع is wrong here).

rejected.reason: تَجْرِى is in a descriptive clause with no jazm particle; indicative with implied damma on the retained ya.
تَجْرِى is in a descriptive clause with no jazm particle; indicative with implied damma on the retained ya.
تُبْلَى follows the adverb يَوْمَ, no jazm particle; indicative passive with implied damma on the alif maqsura.
لَا in فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ is negative (نافية, per the verse i'rab), not prohibitive; the alif is retained, so indicative.
يَخْفَىٰ is in the relative clause of مَا; no governor, alif retained: indicative.
مَن is relative (subject of سَيَذَّكَّرُ), not conditional; يَخْشَىٰ keeps its alif: indicative.
يَصْلَى is in the relative clause of ٱلَّذِى; no governor, alif retained: indicative.
لَا here is negative, parallel to لَا يَمُوتُ (indicative, damma); يَحْيَىٰ keeps its alif: indicative.
تَصْلَىٰ is the predicate of وُجُوهٌ with no governor; alif retained: indicative.
تُسْقَىٰ is a second predicate of وُجُوهٌ with no governor; alif retained: indicative passive.
Negative لَا does not govern jazm; يُغْنِى keeps its ya: indicative, parallel to لَا يُسْمِنُ.
After أَلَمْ, تَرَ is jussive with its final alif dropped; QAC's JUS is correct.
رَبِّىٓ is the subject (mubtada) of أَكْرَمَنِ in quoted speech, not a vocative; nominative implied before the ya.
رَبِّىٓ is the subject (mubtada) of أَهَـٰنَنِ in quoted speech, not a vocative; nominative implied before the ya.
وَجِا۟ىٓءَ is the passive of the hollow verb جَاءَ (jī'a, kasra replaces the u-pattern); بِجَهَنَّمَ is na'ib al-fa'il per the verse i'rab.
After لَمْ, يَرَهُۥٓ is jussive with its final alif dropped; QAC's JUS is correct.
After temporal إِذَا (no jazm), يَغْشَىٰهَا keeps its alif: indicative.
